summary: Freemium tier iteration: 7/7 backend tests pass (plans, billing/me, free project limit 402, AI mentor 402, pro upgrade + unlimited joins + AI review, industry upgrade ~90d, invalid plan 400). Frontend mostly works (pricing page, landing preview, register/badge, pro upgrade, badge flips to PRO, AI mentor modal shows strengths/improvements for Pro, free user AI mentor click correctly shows upgrade modal). CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: Free user's 2nd startup join does NOT show UpgradeModal — instead shows a toast reading '[object Object]'.

ui_bugs.issue: When a Free user tries to join a 2nd startup, backend returns 402 with detail={code:'plan_limit_reached', message, current_plan}. The join() handler does not check detail.code and just calls toast.error(formatApiErrorDetail(detail)). formatApiErrorDetail then hits its fallback (String(detail)) and displays '[object Object]'. Expected: setUpgradePrompt({...}) to open UpgradeModal (as spec requires and as AIMentorModal already does for plan_required).

integration_issues.issue: Never triggers UpgradeModal; instead surfaces '[object Object]' toast.

action_items: Fix StartupDetail.jsx join(): on 402 with detail.code==='plan_limit_reached', call setUpgradePrompt({ message: detail.message, feature: 'Unlimited Startups' }) instead of toast.error.
Harden lib/api.js formatApiErrorDetail() to return detail.message when detail is an object with a message string (currently only checks detail.msg), so error toasts never render '[object Object]'.
critical_code_review_comments: formatApiErrorDetail should support the FastAPI HTTPException(detail={code, message, ...}) shape used across this codebase; add: if (detail && typeof detail.message === 'string') return detail.message;
Payment upgrade is fully mocked — flagged in review request; no real gateway integration. OK per scope.
AIMentorModal already handles plan_required correctly — StartupDetail.join() should follow the same pattern for plan_limit_reached (DRY: extract a helper).
server.py user_plan() correctly downgrades to free on expiry.
test_credentials: admin@launchpad.dev / LaunchPad2026! ; fresh students created per-test via /api/auth/register
seed_data_creation: None beyond registering TEST_ users. Existing 5 seeded startups used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend freemium fully verified via /app/backend/tests/test_freemium.py — rerun with pytest to regress. Frontend outstanding: verify Free user's 2nd startup join renders UpgradeModal (data-testid upgrade-modal-cta) instead of '[object Object]' toast. All other freemium flows (pricing page, landing preview, Pro upgrade + badge refresh, Pro AI mentor modal with strengths/improvements, Free user AI mentor click -> UpgradeModal) already confirmed working.
rca of the issue: Root cause of '[object Object]' toast: lib/api.js formatApiErrorDetail only recognizes detail.msg (Pydantic validation shape) but backend returns detail.message (custom shape). Falls through to String(detail) => '[object Object]'. Additionally, StartupDetail.join() should intercept detail.code==='plan_limit_reached' and open the UpgradeModal (already imported and wired for AI mentor flow) instead of toasting the error. Reproduction: register new user -> apply to any startup -> apply to a second startup -> observe '[object Object]' toast and no modal. Mitigation in action_items.
